No read is accepted while o_empty is 1 (SVA-002).
A rejected request changes no pointer (SVA-003).
o_empty is 1 whenever the scoreboard is empty (SVA-004).
o_full is 1 whenever the scoreboard holds DEPTH words (SVA-005).
o_overflow is 1 in the cycle after a rejected, unblocked write and only then (SVA-006).
o_underflow is 1 in the cycle after a rejected, unblocked read and only then (SVA-007).
The word read equals the word written, per scoreboard (SVA-008).
No request is accepted and no pulse is raised while blocked by the software reset (SVA-009).
o_sw_rst_busy is 1 exactly while the write FSM is not in RUN, one cycle behind the state (SVA-010).
The occupancy is between 0 and DEPTH (SVA-011).
The RTL shall contain no latch, no combinational loop, no tri-state, no clock gating and no derived clock, so that scan insertion is possible.
The IP shall have no DFT ports; any test reset override belongs to the SoC wrapper or reset controller.
CLK-WR and CLK-RD must be defined so STA knows their common period and phase, e.g. generated clocks of one master or primary clocks with one common LCM-period waveform.
PARA_SFIFO_PTR_RETIME = 1 must be used, or the clock ratio changed.
set_clock_groups -asynchronous or set_false_path between CLK-WR and CLK-RD must not be used.
The write and read pointer registers should be placed close to the flag logic of the other domain to shorten the crossing paths.
The software reset must not erase the FIFO memory contents; no secure clearing or zeroization is provided (REQ-SRST-005).

not_verified.note: Memory not erased: memory is visible only through o_rd_data, not meaningful while o_empty=1.

statement: o_rd_data must always present the word at the read pointer, with no valid output signal.
Continuous write and continuous read must show only the initial latency and no gap (gap-free streaming).
There must be no bypass that accepts a write into a full FIFO because a read happens at the same edge.
